synopsis: ISO 31000:2018 and IEC 31010:2019 are jointly identified as documenting risk-management practice [f16341]. The glossary further identifies their risk-management practice and risk-assessment techniques as the basis of the risk register [f15354]. Chapter 12 connects the same standards to both risk-register and risk-matrix practice, extending the glossary’s explanation to planning the work [f9669].

relations.note: Chapter 12 additionally identifies risk-matrix practice alongside the risk register.
Adds risk-assessment techniques and their role as the risk register’s basis.
Specifies risk-register and risk-matrix practice within the standards’ broader risk-management coverage.
